records.rule: Do not bind a mutable default argument; use None plus a fresh object created inside the function.
records.semantics: defaults evaluate once and are shared across calls

records.rule: Do not let a meaningful branch fall through to an implicit None; return or raise on every path.
Test Optional values with 'value is None'; do not rely on truthiness where empty/zero is a legitimate value.
records.semantics: 0, '', [] are falsy; only None denotes absence in an Optional

records.rule: Catch the narrowest exception class applicable; never swallow a real failure into a falsy default.
records.engine_hint: the python rule PYTHON.EXCEPT.BARE is executed by rules check; this article extends it to broad catch-all

records.rule: Prefer an AST-scoped splice over regenerating a module; preserve unrelated bytes and validate before commit.
records.engine_capability: source.python.method.edit with a one-complete-method replacement file

records.rule: Return copies (or read views), not live internals; do not mutate an input the caller owns unless the contract says in place.
records.semantics: assignment/return share the reference; .append/.sort/mutate in place
